The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades near Mezhevaya (Dnepropetrovsk region), Stepanovka, Belozerskoye, Shilovka, Andreyevka, Roganskoye, Starovarvarovka, Veselaya Gora, and Novopavlovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU formations have lost more than 340 troops, seven armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two air assault brigades, one assault brigade, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade close to Gavrilovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Sergeyevka, Barvinovka, Vasilevskoye, Tersyanka, and Volnyanka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 175 troops, one armoured personnel carrier, seven motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
Formations of one mechanised brigade, one mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade have been hit close to Orekhov, Yurkovka, and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 15 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and two motor vehicles have been neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage on
transport infrastructure facilities used by the Armed Forces of Ukraine, UAV launch sites, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 139 areas.

item.title: 🔹 Mine density is high but we move forward Servicemen of the Dnepr Group's engineer units are carrying out engineer reconnaissance and clearing roads to ensure the safety of routes
item.description: Mine density is high but we move forward Servicemen of the Dnepr Group's engineer units are carrying out engineer reconnaissance and clearing roads to ensure the safety of routes leading to the settlement of Aleshki. Roads adjacent to the city are being cleared of explosive objects and unexploded projectiles to deliver humanitarian aid and organise the evacuation of civilians. The majority of explosive objects and mines, mostly of Western production, are scattered or laid by enemy UAVs and are set to be non-removable. In order to ensure the safety of civilians, military engineers destroy them on spot using external charges. One of the Western munitions shown in the footage is a 60 mm HEF mine and it was found in the area of the city bypass road. It was designed to be used in NATO-standard mortars. Military engineers note that such unexploded munitions pose a particular danger to the civilian population, as every slightest mechanical impact can lead to their detonation. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30340

Mine density is high but we move forward
Servicemen of the Dnepr Group's engineer units are carrying out engineer reconnaissance and clearing roads to ensure the safety of routes leading to the settlement of Aleshki.
Roads adjacent to the city are being cleared of explosive objects and unexploded projectiles
to deliver humanitarian aid and organise the evacuation of civilians.
The majority of explosive objects and mines, mostly of Western production, are scattered or laid by enemy UAVs and are set to be non-removable.
In order to ensure the safety of civilians, military engineers destroy them on spot using external charges.
One of the Western munitions shown in the footage is a 60 mm HEF mine and it was found in the area of the city bypass road. It was designed to be used in NATO-standard mortars.
Military engineers note that such unexploded munitions pose a particular danger to the civilian population, as every slightest mechanical impact can lead to their detonation.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
